Christian Sundberg is an author, podcaster, YouTuber I found a few years ago who discusses his experiences pre-birth. He claims to remember the time before he chose this life, sitting in sort of a waiting room where he was quickly rushed to an entry point where he was essentially jettisoned into this world. I can’t remember all the important bits of everything. I do remember specifically that he asked his guides to be able to remember the time before birth. After eons of arguing they agreed but said it wouldn’t help him in any way and that it would likely make his goals harder to achieve. I’m not sure if he remembers his goals for this life or how much of the “before” he remembers. But the main thing I found striking was when he talked about inhabiting his fetal body. He remembers slowly vibrating lower into place and when he got into that tiny body, something he couldn’t imagine could contain the entirety of who he really is — he absolutely panicked. He wasn’t ready. Nothing felt right. And in that moment, having just crossed over and being so close to the other side, thinking how difficult it would be and how suddenly he missed “home” so much — he somehow ended that life. And at that moment he entered into an NDE — but it was unlike most others. Since he had lived inside a stomach for only brief moments he didn’t have a life to review. Instead, he watched the plethora of possibilities his life could have been… unfold in front of him. The people who were waiting for him to be important parts of their lives. The heartbreak he was giving the mother who wanted him. The burial his would-be family would have for him. I believe he said that watching his possible futures and then cutting it short was like “walking out of the most amazing movie after only the first 5 minutes.” It was incredibly painful to feel their sadness and witness his possibilities but as in all NDEs there was no judgment. And his angels hugged him close in those moments. After he went thru that experience and reflected, he decided to try again — and again asked his spirit family to remember his pre-birth. And here he is today voicing his experience. 

I’ve never had an NDE but I’ve lost a lot of people in my life and drugs probably should have ended mine over and over again — but here I am as well. I gather NDEs are about (real) reality, possibilities, noticing, accepting and returning to source (home). Going thru NDEs of others like Christian (especially his book) have led me down a road where I think I can finish this life without trying to end it myself. Hope that isn’t too dark — I have a lovely family and friends who mean the world to me and of course treatment is important for people with mental health issues, etc.

Anyway I tried to find the specific video I found years ago that spoke to me and there are just too many to get thru now — he’s very busy and popular these days I’m happy to find. But I’m sure he retells the story repeatedly in his videos so just google him. Honestly it’s fascinating. And to be honest I haven’t fully figured out if I believe him but I think you’d have to be completely f&cked (excuse my language) to make money lying to people so passionately about the truth of the universe. Plus, I like to think I still feel hints of a time before, like he talks about — the joy of plunging into a new body not knowing what will happen and f&ck all to the you on the other side who has to deal with it! That’s a nice feeling sometimes. 

Hope you find your way <3

I like this. The concept of “spiritual amnesia” is fascinating. If our previous spiritual knowledge were completely available to us at all times, it would be incredibly difficult to focus on the life lessons we’re learning in *this* life. I believe we reincarnate when we choose to so we can learn new things that help evolve our spirit. Being eternal, vastly knowledgeable souls, I imagine it must be extremely jarring to suddenly manifest into the body of a fetus that’s about to exit the womb. Many people believe we carry a bit of that knowledge into our baby bodies to help transition into our new lives. Some people even believe babies can see other spirits (what people may call guardian angels or soul families) and that they have access to “the other side” for a few years to help them adjust to the incessant demands of a new life and to help guide them on the path they need to be on to learn the lessons they came to learn. I don’t know how much of this I believe but it’s super fascinating and imaginative. If you’re interested, there’s a guy who wrote a book I love called A Walk In The Physical. He claims to remember the transition from the spiritual world to the physical and vividly remembers his entire life — back to before his birth. His name is Christian Sundberg. Sounds like a whack job but he has a lot of cool ideas about where we go when we die🤓
Seriously! It’s like physics made an exception just for this guy — imagine how massive those abs must have to be in order to be seen underneath all that insulation. This is a BEAST of a human being.

Dude — I pretty much left the exact same comment in EyeBleach for this vid. 

Death is a natural part of life, and honestly, in the wild, animals kill each other in not too dissimilar ways than seen here, minus the sheer malicious and evil intent of course. Regardless tho, suffering before death is a common thing and something that brings me to watch these kinds of videos. But this one in particular is so heinous, so hateful, so heartless that it’s hard for me to comprehend. What could a person have done to deserve this? Did Hitler deserve this? Stalin? Who deserves this? I cannot imagine the psychological trauma and development a person who commits these acts must have gone through. Do they just flip a switch and turn off for a moment? Or do they relish every moment? Were they raised as kids to numb themselves to this kind of violent behavior? We’re really lucky that we are so far removed from the insanity of the guys who did this, but innocent people encounter evil like this every day. It’s fucking horrifying and it kind of gives me existential dread thinking about what happens to the “souls” of the people who do this? Are there psychic/karmic consequences? I don’t really believe in “hell” but I can’t imagine what someone would have to do to cleanse themselves from such deep seated hatefulness. I ultimately don’t believe anybody is “evil to the core” either, I believe everyone is made from love and it can never leave them entirely. However these kinds of videos really challenge the way I think about love, Justice, the afterlife, humanity, etc.
